description: Enables Wireframe blocks in TmNotionEditor. When supplied, users can create and edit wireframe/mockup diagrams in a full-screen modal powered by TmWireframeEditor. Without this provider the Wireframe block type is hidden from the slash menu.

methods.name: GetWireframeDocumentAsync
methods.description: Loads a wireframe document by ID. Returns null if the document does not yet exist.

methods.name: SaveWireframeDocumentAsync
methods.description: Persists a wireframe document and returns the saved version.

methods.name: CreateWireframeDocumentAsync
methods.description: Creates a new empty wireframe document and returns its ID along with the document.
